enrichment.headline: Awards Deco Tech Systems $181,300 for new security cameras at Acorn Woodland and Esperanza schools
enrichment.summary: Deco Tech Systems will install about 39 new security cameras, troubleshoot about 3 existing ones, supply 5 spare cameras and replace the recording server. The price includes a $15,000 contingency allowance, and Deco Tech was the lowest responsive bidder. Work is expected to run from February 26, 2026 to June 26, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Awards Redgwick Construction $847,700 for site work for the Calvin Simmons turf field replacement
enrichment.summary: Redgwick Construction will do site preparation, demolition, grading and drainage work to prepare for a new synthetic turf field at Calvin Simmons Middle School, working with Shaw Sports Turf. The price includes a $125,000 contingency allowance, and Redgwick was the lowest responsive bidder. Work is expected to run from February 26, 2026 to June 6, 2026.
